title: More details about the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra's cameras emerge
description: Back in late August, a rumor claimed Samsung would equip the Galaxy S27 Ultra with a new telephoto camera with 4x optical zoom. This would have used a 1/1.9" type sensor. Earlier this week, however, another source vehemently denied this, claiming that the S27 Ultra would have the exact same 5x optical zoom telephoto camera as its predecessor. Today a new, usually reliable source has chimed in on the controversy as well. According to Roland Quandt, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will use a 50MP 5x optical zoom telephoto camera with a Sony sensor. So it's not going to be 4x optical zoom, which...

title: Analyst Jeff Pu is not impressed with iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max pre-orders
description: Analyst Jeff Pu has been keeping track of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max wait times for the various configurations. Based on that data, Pu says that the pre-order wait times are “lukewarm”. The stats are as follows. The most popular 256GB and 512GB models are showing 3-4 week wait times for most colors. Pricier 1TB and 2TB models are available immediately if you want a Silver phone, with 1-2 weeks wait times for Black and Glacier models and 3-4 weeks for the Burgundy version. It’s easy to tell that the new Burgundy color is by far the most popular option, while the Silver color...

title: Samsung will reportedly raise DRAM and NAND prices for smartphone makers
description: Korean publication Sisa Journal e reports that Samsung Electronics (the DS division, specifically) wants to increase the prices of DRAM and NAND for smartphones by 7% to 10%. Chinese smartphone makers are first – negotiations with them are already underway. Apple will be asked back to the negotiating table in Q4 (October-December). Even Samsung’s smartphone division will not be spared (the DS and DX divisions operate separately). Apple may be a tough cookie to crack, though. description: According to online reports citing unnamed inside sources, Samsung is planning to hit the gas when it comes to foldables, following the recent announcement of the iPhone Duo. description: After several teasers, the design of the upcoming Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition has finally been revealed. The company has also confirmed the phone’s launch date in India. This marks Realme’s second smartphone collaboration with Warner Bros. The Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition will debut in India on September 21. In an official press-release, the company noted that the special edition smartphone will feature a brown-finish leather texture rear panel with an Argyle pattern. title: Xiaomi 18 Pro series launch officially teased
description: After unveiling the Xiaomi 18 Fold last week, the Chinese manufacturer is now gearing up to launch the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. While Xiaomi has yet to announce a launch date, the company has officially begun teasing its upcoming flagship lineup. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series will launch in China later this month, the company confirmed in a teaser video shared on Weibo. The teaser offers a first look at the rear panel of the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro series, including the rear display similar to the one found on the Xiaomi 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max. title: The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is one of the first Dimensity 9600 Pro phones and will be available globally
description: Oppo has confirmed that the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be available globally and that it will be one of the first flagships to use the fresh-out-of-the-oven Dimensity 9600 Pro. The phone itself hasn’t been fully unveiled yet – it will launch in China on September 22 and there will be a separate global launch next month. The Pro Max model, along with the Find X10 and Find X10 E, is listed on Oppo’s store in China. We’re not sure whether all three will be available globally, however, or whether they have the same configurations. The Pro Max is listed with 12GB/256GB, 12GB/512GB, 16GB/512GB...

title: OnePlus N6 Lite to debut next week with a 7,000mAh battery
description: The OnePlus N6 Lite, the latest addition to the company’s N series lineup in India, now has an official launch date. OnePlus has also revealed some key features of the upcoming phone, including its 7,000mAh battery. OnePlus will launch the N6 Lite in India on September 22. The phone will be available in two color options and can be purchased through Amazon and OnePlus’ official online store. title: The Samsung Galaxy A18 4G launches with a new chipset, IP64 rating and a notch
description: Samsung quietly launched the Galaxy A18 in Europe – we found press releases for France, Norway and Sweden. This is a 4G phone and there is no A18 5G variant just yet. This phone is a fairly minor upgrade over the Galaxy A17 4G. The biggest change is that Samsung dropped the Helio G99 chipset in favor of the Exynos 1610. You haven’t heard of the Exynos 1610? Well, we hadn’t either and Samsung is not forthcoming with the details. title: The Dimensity 9600 Pro is a 2nm chip with Arm C2 cores and Mali-G2 Ultra NX GPU
description: MediaTek just unveiled the Dimensity 9600 Pro – this is the company’s first 2nm chipset and the first to use Arm’s next-gen CPU and GPU designs. It brings notable performance upgrades across the board with special attention paid to AI compute. The CPU layout has been reshuffled – there are now two Ultra-class CPU cores at the expense of one small Pro core. The exact configuration is 2x Arm C2-Ultra + 3x C2-Pro + 3x C2-Pro (we don’t know the clock speeds yet). The CPU promises 17% higher single-core performance and 37% higher efficiency. title: iOS 27 now seeding, here are all the iPhones getting it
description: Apple is rolling out iOS 27 to users today. This update brings a host of improvements, including refinements to Liquid Glass, up to 30% faster app load times, revamped Spotlight, Photos, and Mail search functionality, and Apple’s revamped Siri AI. Siri AI is rolling out in Beta with English-only support and will not be available initially in the EU. Support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish is coming in October. title: iQOO 16 launch date and color options revealed
description: Last week, iQOO offered a glimpse at the redesigned rear camera module of its upcoming iQOO 16. The company later confirmed that the phone will use Samsung’s new M16 display panel with a 165Hz refresh rate and 2K resolution. Now, iQOO has revealed the handset’s launch date and color options. The iQOO 16 will launch in China on September 29 and will go on sale on the same day, the company confirmed in a post on Weibo. description: A few days ago, the Samsung Galaxy A08 was listed by an online retailer in the UAE, and now the Korean company has decided to make it official, with no fanfare, no official press release, nothing like that. Samsung has just simply added the Galaxy A08 to its website in both Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina. The device comes with a 6.7-inch PLS LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution, a 50MP rear camera with f/1.8 aperture, a 2MP f/2.4 auxiliary rear camera, an 8MP front camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery. description: Last week Oppo started teasing the upcoming F35 series in India, confirming that it's going to be launching soon. Today, a new leak purports to show us both devices in some leaked renders. We are assuming that the F35 Pro is on top here, as that would neatly fit with previous rumors claiming it would be a rebranded A7 Pro Max, which has the exact same design. title: Honor Play11 gets official with an 8,300 mAh battery and the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC
description: Honor's increasingly vast Play11 family has added a new member today, namely the 'vanilla' Honor Play11. This device comes with a 6.872-inch LCD screen with 720x1592 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,020-nit peak brightness. On the rear there's a 50MP camera with f/1.8 aperture, while on the front there’s a 5MP selfie shooter. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC, paired with 6/8GB of RAM and 128/256GB of storage. title: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 may be made in part by Samsung
description: According to a new report from Korea today, Qualcomm is still in talks with Samsung about the latter joining TSMC in making the former's upcoming flagship Snapdragon chips. Qualcomm is expected to announce the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro later this month, and a lot of prior rumors have suggested that TSMC will be the only foundry making them. However, today's new report claims Qualcomm is still open to a dual-source setup with TSMC and Samsung. title: iPhone Duo may become an entire product line, new rumor claims
description: For a long time the first foldable iPhone was rumored to be called iPhone Ultra, but Apple actually went with iPhone Duo as you may know. If you were wondering why, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has an intriguing theory. According to him, Apple is planning multiple foldable iPhones for the future - a bigger iPhone Duo Max, a smaller iPhone Duo mini, and even an entry-level iPhone Duo SE.
